name: Dawn Drop: Radiant Beginnings
source:
Take the first steps into Dawn Drop as freshman Dimitri Sol as he optimistically enters college in the hopes of filling a "Void" he feels in his chest. A void that appeared a few years ago after an "accident" which tells him that he is missing something important in his life and while it could be that he is unhappy, missing love or maybe wealth, not even he himself knows what it could be.

Left with an Custom E-quip made by his father known as "Avarice" and "benevolence" which take the shape of twin bracelets with unknown properties, Dimitri also hopes to find out why the event that changed his life years ago took place. Although without any leads or clues, he instead follows his fathers advice of attending his Alma mater, Glenais university.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/dawn-drop-radiant-beginnings-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

The project has been [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/dawn-drop-radiant-beginnings-visual-novel/posts/2912564]cancelled[/url] and all of the game assets have been released for [url=https://sunrivierastudios.itch.io/dawn-drop-asset-bundle]free[/url].
translation:
以大一新生德米特里．索爾的身分，懷抱著填補胸中「空洞」的希望，樂觀地踏入大學，邁出《黎明墜落》的第一步。幾年前，一場「事故」留下了這個空洞，讓他意識到人生缺少某種重要事物——也許是不幸福，也許是缺少愛情或財富，但連他自己也不知道那究竟是什麼。

父親製作的特製裝備「貪婪」與「仁慈」化作一對性質不明的手鐲。德米特里還希望查明多年前改變自己人生的事件為何發生。雖然沒有任何線索，他還是聽從父親建議，進入父親的母校格萊奈斯大學。

[來源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/dawn-drop-radiant-beginnings-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter募資頁面[/url]]

本計畫已[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/dawn-drop-radiant-beginnings-visual-novel/posts/2912564]取消[/url]，所有遊戲素材已[url=https://sunrivierastudios.itch.io/dawn-drop-asset-bundle]免費發佈[/url]。
